description.text: An expansion pack of the Pokémon Card Game series, released on 8 April 2005 after an early start at Pokémon Centers on 4 April. Its theme is Ho-Oh, Lugia and the other Pokémon of Gold and Silver, with many strong Darkness and Metal Pokémon ex such as Umbreon ex, Tyranitar ex, Steelix ex and Scizor ex. The legendary beasts Entei, Suicune and Raikou are its Star cards. The cards are numbered to 106. In English it became EX Unseen Forces in August 2005.
